mapper.select: SELECT wo.*, po.order_number, p.product_name FROM work_orders wo LEFT JOIN production_orders po ON wo.production_order_id = po.id LEFT JOIN products p ON po.product_id = p.id ORDER BY wo.id
SELECT wo.*, po.order_number, p.product_name FROM work_orders wo LEFT JOIN production_orders po ON wo.production_order_id = po.id LEFT JOIN products p ON po.product_id = p.id WHERE wo.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO work_orders (work_order_number, production_order_id, workstation, operation, planned_hours, actual_hours, status, assigned_to, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{workOrderNumber}, #{productionOrderId}, #{workstation}, #{operation}, #{plannedHours}, #{actualHours}, #{status}, #{assignedTo}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE work_orders SET work_order_number = #{workOrderNumber}, production_order_id = #{productionOrderId}, workstation = #{workstation}, operation = #{operation}, planned_hours = #{plannedHours}, actual_hours = #{actualHours}, status = #{status}, assigned_to = #{assignedTo}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
